title: Epistemic Constitutionalism Or: how to avoid coherence bias.
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark on religion itself. It cites a previous study (Van der Linden et al., 2018) that measured source attribution bias by testing how atheists' and Christians' agreement with non-divisive aphorisms changed when the aphorisms were attributed to the Bible versus other sources.
findings: The paper does not present its own findings on religion. It cites findings from Van der Linden et al. (2018) which established that source attribution affects agreement along religious lines: 'atheists agreed less with aphorisms presented as Bible verses, while Christians agreed more.'
